applies_to: Guidewire PolicyCenter 10.x / Guidewire Cloud / earlier on-premise
info_to_collect: Policy, term and job number of the failing change
Change effective date and effective dates of all later bound jobs
What was changed (driver, vehicle/VIN, coverage, named insured)
Exact error text, screenshot, user ID and time with time zone
Whether the job was approved / UW referral cleared; other policies affected?
title: OOS endorsement deletes or loses drivers/operators or vehicles
symptoms: Operators/drivers deleted or missing on later transactions after an OOS endorsement
OOS endorsement will not book because operators are missing
Internal error on OOS after a VIN change or backdated vehicle removal
cause: When an out-of-sequence change binds, PolicyCenter applies its differences to every later job (roll-forward), matching effective-dated entities by FixedId. If a VIN change or CRM contact sync replaces a driver/vehicle instead of updating it, the merge sees delete-plus-add and custom conflict handling drops the entity from later slices.
diagnosis: Confirm OOS: change effective date is earlier than a later bound job (Policy File > Transactions)
Compare driver and vehicle lists slice by slice; note FixedIds and VINs
Review the Out of Sequence Conflicts step for unexpected removals
resolution: Re-create it with only the driver/vehicle edits; resolve conflicts keeping future values for unrelated entities
Apply VIN or other edits as a separate same-date change
If later slices already lost operators, L3 re-keys them or runs an approved data fix
workaround: Key the change effective at the first later job's date with an underwriting note, if the business allows.
permanent_fix: Fix FixedId-preserving update logic in custom OOS and CRM-sync code (Problem record).
escalation: PC L2 Application Support > PC L3 Policy Transactions. Escalate if a data fix is needed or more than one policy is affected.
